SLOT gestureSlots INSERT TEMPLATE swipes{
	id: swipeForQuick
	distance: 0.5 
	direction: Qt.point(1, 0) 
	conditionName: primaryOr
	condition: (documentViewTools.activeTool === "primary")
	releaseRequired: false
	areas: Qt.rect(0, 0, touchArea.width, touchArea.edgeSize)
	fingers: 1
	action:{toolbar.floatbarQuickk = !toolbar.floatbarQuickk}
}
END SLOT
SLOT gestureSlots INSERT TEMPLATE swipes{
	id: swipeForQuickReset
	distance: 0.5 
	releaseRequired: false
	direction: Qt.point(-1, 0) 
	conditionName: primaryOr
	condition: (documentViewTools.activeTool === "primary")
	areas: Qt.rect(0, 0, touchArea.width, touchArea.edgeSize)
	fingers: 1
	action:{toolbar.resetFloatBarPosition()}
}
END SLOT
